projects.title: Engineering Notebook
projects.cardDesc: This isn't just a single project; it's a collection of moments, each with its own story. Hands-on work, technical drawings, lab experiments, etc.
projects.overview: A curated collection of miscellaneous hands-on engineering work accumulated throughout academic and professional activities. This notebook captures the breadth of practical skills - from workshop machining and mechanical assembly to electronics lab experiments, technical drafting, and component inspection.
bullets: Mechanical component assembly and disassembly (pistons, connecting rods, gear systems).
Hand-drafted technical engineering drawings with proper projection and dimensioning.
Electronics breadboard experiments and circuit measurements.
Workshop machining, part inspection, and tooling activities.
Various lab practicals covering machine elements, materials, and manufacturing processes.

projects.title: Digital Twin & Robotics Integration (Industry 5.0)
projects.cardDesc: Synchronized digital twin pipeline for the SO-100 robot, bridging Fusion 360 CAD with ROS2 motion planning via Unity and NVIDIA Isaac Sim.
projects.overview: Developed a complete digital twin pipeline for the SO-100 open-source robotic arm, bridging CAD design directly into real-time simulation and motion-planning environments. The workflow spans Fusion 360 URDF export, ROS2 integration, Unity visualization, and NVIDIA Isaac Sim validation.
bullets: Custom Fusion 360 URDF/XACRO exporter - automated joint and mesh extraction.
ROS2 Humble integration with MoveIt2 for inverse kinematics and trajectory planning.
Unity-based real-time digital twin with ROS2 TCP Connector bridge.
NVIDIA Isaac Sim HIL validation and sim-to-real gap analysis.
Python toolchain for URDF post-processing and mesh optimization.

projects.title: Custom 5-Axis Slicing Engine
projects.cardDesc: Custom slicing logic enabling non-linear 5-axis toolpaths beyond 3-axis constraints, improving mechanical properties and reducing support structures.
projects.overview: Developed a custom 5-axis slicing engine from scratch, enabling non-planar and non-linear toolpath generation for FDM 3D printing. The engine supports continuous fiber reinforcement strategies and eliminates support structures in complex geometries.
bullets: Custom toolpath generation algorithm for 5-axis FDM printing.
Non-planar layer computation with surface normal tracking.
G-code post-processor compatible with multi-axis motion controllers.
Fiber path optimization for continuous carbon fiber reinforcement.
Perl-based geometry kernel with Python front-end for path validation.

projects.title: Deep Drawing FEA
projects.cardDesc: As part of the Non-Linear Finite Element Methods course, I simulated a deep drawing process using Explicit Dynamics to predict material behavior under high-strain conditions.
projects.overview: Finite element analysis of a deep drawing manufacturing process using ANSYS Explicit Dynamics. The study focused on predicting sheet metal deformation, stress distribution, and failure modes under large-strain forming conditions as part of the Non-Linear Finite Element Methods course.
bullets: ANSYS Explicit Dynamics model setup for deep drawing simulation.
Material model calibration using experimental stress-strain data.
Wrinkling and tearing failure prediction under varying blank-holder forces.
Mesh sensitivity analysis and convergence validation.
Comparison with analytical solutions and experimental reference data.

projects.title: Advanced Measurement Systems & Metrology
projects.cardDesc: Programming and managing robotic arms, VMMs, CMMs, and 3D optical scanning systems for high-precision inspection at ZALNER.
projects.overview: Hands-on metrology work at ZALNER Engineering covering programming and operation of CMMs, VMMs, robotic inspection arms, and 3D optical scanning systems. Focus on high-precision dimensional verification, GD&T evaluation, and measurement system analysis for automotive and precision manufacturing clients.
bullets: CMM programming in DMIS and ZEISS Inspect for complex prismatic and freeform parts.
3D scanning workflows with GOM and PolyWorks for reverse engineering and inspection.
Measurement System Analysis (MSA) - Gauge R&R studies for production lines.
GD&T evaluation and reporting per ASME Y14.5 and ISO GPS standards.
Tool presetter calibration and retrofit at Heilig GmbH.

projects.title: Vehicle Maintenance
projects.cardDesc: PPAP, APQP, SPC, and 8D quality engineering in an IATF 16949 certified automotive supply chain environment.
projects.overview: Quality engineering work within an IATF 16949 certified automotive supply chain at ZALNER Engineering. Responsibilities spanned PPAP submissions, APQP planning, statistical process control, and 8D problem resolution for precision mechanical components supplied to Tier-1 automotive manufacturers.
bullets: PPAP Level 3 submissions - full documentation including PFMEA, control plans, and MSA.
SPC chart management and Cpk analysis for critical dimensions.
8D problem-solving reports for customer escapes and internal non-conformances.
APQP project coordination from design review through production validation.
Internal audit support and corrective action plan development under IATF 16949.

projects.title: Optimization of Medical Device Manufacturing Technology
projects.cardDesc: Bachelor's thesis - optimization of orthodontic plier manufacturing utilizing CAD/CAM/CAE, ensuring EU MDR and ISO 13485 compliance. TDK 3rd Place.
projects.h1: Optimization of Medical Device Manufacturing Technology
projects.overview: Bachelor's thesis project focused on optimizing the manufacturing process of orthodontic pliers at Mobilinter Kft. The project combined CAD redesign, 5-axis CNC CAM programming, and FEA structural validation to improve manufacturing efficiency while ensuring full compliance with EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485.
bullets: CAD redesign of orthodontic plier geometry in Fusion 360 for improved manufacturability.
5-axis CNC CAM programming and fixture design for complex freeform surfaces.
FEA structural analysis - stress, deformation, and fatigue life evaluation.
Hot die forging feasibility study per DIN EN 10243.
Full regulatory documentation package - EU MDR and ISO 13485 compliance.

projects.title: Stepper Motor Controller
projects.cardDesc: Design and build of a stepper motor controller - PCB design, firmware development, and mechanical integration for position-controlled actuation.
projects.overview: End-to-end design and build of a stepper motor controller board - from schematic capture and PCB layout, through firmware development in Embedded C, to physical assembly and testing. The system enables precise position and speed control for a NEMA 17 stepper motor.
bullets: Schematic design and PCB layout in KiCad - 2-layer board with DRV8825 driver.
Firmware in Embedded C - step/direction control with acceleration profiles.
Closed-loop position control using optical encoder feedback.
Mechanical enclosure design and integration with actuator assembly.
Testing and validation - step accuracy, speed ramp, and thermal characterisation.

projects.title: Vehicle Maintenance
projects.cardDesc: Hands-on vehicle servicing covering engine, brakes, suspension, and drivetrain - diagnostics and mechanical repair in a real workshop setting.
projects.overview: Hands-on vehicle maintenance and mechanical servicing covering diagnostics, component inspection, disassembly/reassembly, and system-level troubleshooting in a real-world workshop environment.
bullets: Engine and drivetrain component disassembly, inspection, and reassembly.
Brake system servicing - pads, discs, callipers, and fluid.
Suspension and steering component inspection and adjustment.
Diagnostic procedures and fault identification across mechanical systems.
Fluid servicing - engine oil, coolant, transmission, and power steering.

projects.title: Tool Presetter Retrofit
projects.cardDesc: Full mechanical overhaul and calibration of a tool presetter, restoring it to precision metrology standards for CNC tool measurement.
projects.overview: Complete mechanical retrofit and recalibration of a legacy tool presetter at Heilig GmbH. The project involved disassembly, full mechanical overhaul, geometric re-alignment, and calibration to restore the instrument to traceable metrology standards for CNC tool offset measurement.
bullets: Full disassembly and mechanical inspection of all kinematic components.
Precision geometric re-alignment of measuring axes and datum surfaces.
Calibration against traceable reference artefacts - length, diameter, runout.
Measurement Uncertainty analysis and calibration certificate development.
Operator training and documentation of maintenance procedures.

projects.title: Material Characterisation
projects.cardDesc: Mechanical testing, microstructural analysis, and property evaluation of engineering materials - tensile, hardness, impact, and failure analysis.
projects.overview: Systematic characterisation of engineering materials through mechanical testing and microstructural analysis. Work spans tensile testing, hardness measurement, impact testing, and failure analysis across metals, polymers, and composites.
bullets: Tensile testing - stress-strain curve acquisition and property extraction (UTS, YS, elongation).
Vickers and Brinell hardness testing across different material conditions.
Charpy impact testing for toughness and ductile-to-brittle transition.
Optical and SEM microstructural analysis - grain size, phase identification, fracture surface.
Failure analysis reports with root cause identification.

projects.title: FEM & Simulation Studies
projects.cardDesc: A collection of structural, thermal, dynamic, and nonlinear FEM simulations completed during engineering studies - images & animations.
projects.overview: A curated collection of finite element method and simulation studies completed throughout mechanical engineering studies. Covers static structural, modal, thermal, explicit dynamics, and nonlinear analyses using ANSYS Mechanical, ANSYS Explicit Dynamics, MATLAB, and Abaqus.
bullets: Static structural analysis - stress, deformation, fatigue under various loading conditions.
Modal and harmonic analysis - natural frequencies and resonance evaluation.
Thermal analysis - heat transfer, thermal stress, and gradient mapping.
Explicit Dynamics - high-strain-rate forming, impact, and crash simulations.
Non-linear FEM - large deformation, contact mechanics, material non-linearity.
